scripts.build: npm run build -w app && npm run build -w functions && npm run build -w mcp
scripts.test: vitest run tests/domain.test.ts tests/duplicate-pack.test.ts tests/pack-selection.test.ts tests/assembly.test.ts tests/reprints.test.ts tests/api-contract.test.ts tests/mcp.test.ts tests/deletion.test.ts tests/delete-session.test.ts tests/organisation.test.ts tests/public-runsheet.test.ts
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-rundown --only firestore,storage 'vitest run tests/rules.test.ts'
scripts.test:render: npm run build -w app && node scripts/smoke-header.mjs && node scripts/smoke-colors.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w app && npm run typecheck -w functions && npm run typecheck -w mcp
scripts.test:api: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-rundown --only auth,firestore,storage,functions 'vitest run tests/api.integration.test.ts'
